bloodied.text: At 95hp summon a icy storm, others are Blind beyond Reach/Range 6 and take 1d6 damage at the end of each of their turns.

flavor: A name whispered in reverence and fear among the highland tribes and northern scholars alike. She slumbers beneath the ruins of Skeldrim Hollow, a shattered temple buried in ice, guarded by frost-wights who chant in dead tongues. But recent tremors in the permafrost and the unnatural stilling of the wind have led some to believe she stirs again—awakened not by hunger, but by prophecy. They say when Iskaryth flies once more, she will not return alone.

tactics.easier: Iskareth can say "YOU ALL WILL BE BITTEN BY FROST!" and spend a few turns flying with Biting each hero "WHO'S NEXT?", greatly reducing her damage output (and allowing the heroes to RP and try to deceive her or heal through the Frostbite and catch up). Return to the normal tactics when you feel the heroes have regained the upper hand.
tactics.harder: Regain Blizzard once when Dying and increase the DC to 16 (or they must deal 16 Bludgeoning or Fire damage). Instead of a straight line, you can use Wall of Ice to completely encircle a hero!

name: Vorgrath, the Insatiable
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn perform 1 action (rec. in order).

actions.name: Bow Before Me!
actions.text: Each hero rolls 3d20. Allow each to bow (become Prone) or take that much damage.

actions.name: Serve Me!
actions.text: (Prone target) Spend 3 actions for them (they regain any spent actions).

actions.name: Suffer!
actions.text: Fly 8 then Ichorbolt. (Range 8) d66 damage to creatures in a 3x3 area.

bloodied.name: BLEED WITH ME!
bloodied.text: At 187 HP, Vorgrath inflicts Lacerated on all heroes: Lacerated. Suffer 1 damage for each space you move (or are moved). Healing or a DC 15 Examination check ends.

lastStand.name: Your Pain Will Be Unending!
lastStand.text: Vorgrath is dying! 140 more damage and he dies! Until then he can force a hero within Reach 8 to Interpose for him (1 time use).

flavor:
In the deepest reaches of the Horrible Beyond lies the profane citadel, Ebonreach, and sitting atop the cursed black throne is the realm's most feared creature: Vorgrath, the Insatiable. No records tell of when Vorgrath first took the throne; some say he has always sat upon it. Commander and Lord of all fiends, he demands fealty and endless tribute from his progeny. Those that fail are ripped asunder without a second thought.

Conqueror of the black depths, his goal now is to rise and conquer the world beyond the White Gate, spreading his hate and poison to the farthest corners of the known lands and beyond.

tactics.easier: Use his "Serve Me!" to move the heroes around rather than attack one another. Have him land after using "Suffer!" action, perhaps demanding fealty again, to allow the heroes to attack from melee if they dare! Lacerated could end after 1 round.
tactics.harder: Use heroes to make melee attacks against their Prone allies. Move heroes into dangerous terrain. Gain an additional use of his Last Stand Ability.
